scope: journaled job/prompt adapter over owned Linux software terminal with explicit software-only evidence provider
covered: immutable staged bytes and source/staged hash checks; duplicate requests do not redispatch
start/resume/cancel and final completion require job/host/generation/operation/phase/time/scope-bound typed evidence, not bare boolean or sender state
pause requires complete fresh checkpoint or returns unknown and refuses resume
deadlines and provider exceptions remain unknown; no physical stop claim
owned cancellation remains available after staged-file corruption
stream progress does not stale pause requests; paused stream changes still advance expected state version

regression.symptom: every queued streaming command changed control state version, intermittently rejecting otherwise current pause requests
regression.fixed: stream epoch participates in expected-state validation while paused; job/control/prompt/fault changes still update the version

limits: evidence test provider reads private virtual-peer fields and labels all facts software_only_virtual_peer
evidence IDs/hashes are references, not physical certificates; no actual hardware provider is supplied
actual source-timed serial observation/provider, restart/reconnect, resend/saturation/shutdown and physical policy qualification remain unfinished
physical board/screen/recovery, sensor/clearance and camera/mount qualification remain open
